name: meridian__member__savings_balance
description:
Look up a member by member number in Meridian Core Servicing and return the balance of their regular share savings account, along with the member's name for confirmation. Read-only.
Returns on success:
  memberName (string): The member's name as held on the core, for the caller to confirm identity.
  savingsBalance (money): Ledger balance of the regular share savings account.
May instead return one of these business outcomes, which are answers rather than errors:
  MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: The member number does not exist on this core. A valid answer, not a fault.
  FIELD_VALIDATION_REJECTED: The application rejected a field value. Returned to the caller so it can correct the input rather than retrying the same value.
Risk tier: read_only.

memberName.description: The member's name as held on the core, for the caller to confirm identity.

The application itself failed - a transaction abend. Escalated rather than returned: nothing the caller can do with this, and a person needs the reference number to raise it with the service desk.
The stored operator credential was refused. Escalated because it is an estate problem - a locked or rotated service account - and no retry fixes it.

name: meridian__member__subaccount_open
description:
Open a new share sub-account on an existing member in Meridian Core Servicing and return the confirmation reference. Commits a new share record; requires approval before unattended use.
Returns on success:
  confirmationNumber (string): The posting confirmation reference shown on the final screen.
May instead return one of these business outcomes, which are answers rather than errors:
  PRODUCT_NOT_PERMITTED: The share product is not valid for this member class.
  MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: The member number does not exist on this core. A valid answer, not a fault.
  FIELD_VALIDATION_REJECTED: The application rejected a field value. Returned to the caller so it can correct the input rather than retrying the same value.
Risk tier: irreversible. This capability commits changes that cannot be undone from the screen.
